regime_context: The policy regime remains a sequenced campaign of low-real-yield engineering and strategic re-industrialization: the Fed is credibility-banking with hawkish guidance while Treasury suppresses front-end yields structurally, and the Iran ceasefire collapse has created a stagflationary split that strengthens the energy bid but raises the cost of the whole framework. The consensus narrative treats the hawkish Fed tape as a simple tightening signal, but revealed preference shows the administration wants the outcome of lower real yields without the optics of near-term cuts — so the front end, not the long end, is where the policy intent actually lives.
regime_context_zh: 政策体制仍是一场有序推进的低实际利率工程与战略再工业化运动：美联储正以鹰派指引积累信誉，财政部则在结构上压低前端收益率，而伊朗停火破裂造成的滞胀分化强化了能源交易机会，却抬高了整个框架的成本。市场共识把美联储鹰派表态简单视为紧缩信号，但显示性偏好表明，政府想要的是低实际利率这一结果，而不是近期降息的表象——因此真正的政策意图体现在前端而非长端。

theses.subject: XLE
theses.thesis: The Iran ceasefire collapse re-primes an upside-skewed oil bid exactly when the administration's stagflationary split makes energy the highest-visibility inflation hedge that doesn't require the Fed to cave. Revealed interest is to let Brent spike as the FX bridge while front-end yields stay suppressed; ETF inflows into energy were already the strongest sector rotation in Q1 2026.
theses.thesis_zh: 伊朗停火破裂重新激活了原油上行倾斜的配置逻辑，而此时正是政府面临的滞胀分化让能源成为最显眼的通胀对冲工具、且无需美联储让步的时点。显示性利益是让布伦特上涨作为汇率桥梁，同时保持前端收益率受抑；2026 年一季度能源已是 ETF 资金流入最强的板块轮动。
evidence: Iran/Middle East theater: ceasefire COLLAPSED as of 7/8; Brent spiked ~$80 intraday
Energy was the TOP ETF-inflow sector Q1 2026 (first in years)
Rotation map lists XLE/XOP under Energy with FACT mechanism (headline-fragile)
theses.dissent: Oil is headline-fragile in both directions: any de-escalation or Hormuz reassurance can unwind the spike faster than the ETF inflow momentum can hold it, and a ceasefire truce over the next 6 weeks would face a crowded energy trade.
theses.dissent_zh: 原油高度依赖消息面且双向脆弱：任何局势降级或霍尔木兹海峡局势缓和，都可能比 ETF 资金流入动能更快地瓦解油价涨幅，而未来六周若出现停火休战，将使多头拥挤的能源交易承压。

falsifier.text: XLE lags SPY by 5% or more before late November 2026 despite no new Iran de-escalation
falsifier.text_zh: 在 2026 年 11 月下旬之前，XLE 在伊朗没有新的缓和情况下仍落后 SPY 5% 或以上

theses.subject: TLT
theses.thesis: The Fed's revealed preference is inflation-mandate first, labor-crack second: hot May PCE plus a >70% Sept-hike probability pushes the long end toward repricing higher real yields. Treasury suppression operates on the front end (bills, buybacks, dealer reform), so the long end remains the pressure-release valve for a hawkish Fed credibility campaign.
theses.thesis_zh: 美联储的显示性偏好是通胀使命优先、就业疲弱次之：5 月 PCE 偏热叠加 9 月加息概率超过 70%，推动长端向更高的实际收益率重新定价。财政部的收益率抑制作用于前端（短债、回购、交易商改革），因此长端仍是美联储鹰派信誉战役的泄压阀。
evidence: Sintra response held hawkish line: 'prices are too high'; declined to signal July
CME FedWatch moved to >70% probability of a Sept hike after Iran strike
Open prediction: Fed does NOT cut at July and September 2026 meetings
theses.dissent: A widening labor crack — June payrolls already missed at +57k — could flip the Fed toward a data-driven September pivot, and any 2026 cut ahead of the median path would compress long-end yields sharply while the front-end trade is already crowded.
theses.dissent_zh: 若就业裂口扩大——6 月非农已不及预期仅 +57k——美联储可能转向数据驱动的 9 月宽松，而任何早于中位路径的 2026 年降息都将大幅压低长端收益率，同时前端交易已过于拥挤。

falsifier.text: TLT outperforms SPY by 5% or more before mid-December 2026 on a dovish Fed repricing
falsifier.text_zh: 在 2026 年 12 月中旬之前，TLT 因美联储转鸽重新定价而跑赢 SPY 5% 或以上

theses.subject: XLF
theses.thesis: A hike-majority front end plus Treasury dealer-intermediation reform and eSLR progress all point to steepening curve dynamics and improved dealer-bank carry. Financials are the only sector that benefits directly from both the Fed's hawkish credibility phase and the administration's structural funding realignment.
theses.thesis_zh: 前端加息概率占优，叠加财政部交易商中介改革和 eSLR 进展，均指向收益率曲线陡峭化与交易商银行息差改善。金融板块是唯一同时受益于美联储鹰派信誉阶段和财政部结构性融资重排的板块。
evidence: Dollar/debt theater: dealer-intermediation reform, buybacks reinforce front-end
Open predictions: concrete eSLR-reform progress; SEC Treasury central-clearing expansion
Rotation map: Financials/dealer banks XLF, KBE under FACT mechanism
theses.dissent: The prior XLF overweight call in July missed (-8.2% on KBE, -5.4% on XLF); if the labor crack widens and the Fed pivots, the steepener premium in dealer banks unwinds and the front-end carry trade loses its hawkish anchor.
theses.dissent_zh: 此前 7 月对 XLF 的超配判断已经失误（KBE 录得 -8.2%，XLF 录得 -5.4%）；若就业裂口扩大且美联储转向宽松，交易商银行中的陡峭化溢价将消退，前端息差交易也将失去鹰派锚定。

falsifier.text: XLF lags SPY by 5% or more before mid-December 2026 despite no Fed easing
falsifier.text_zh: 在 2026 年 12 月中旬之前，XLF 在美联储没有宽松的情况下仍落后 SPY 5% 或以上

theses.subject: SMH
theses.thesis: The China tech-war transition is the key contingent onshoring lever: the SCOTUS strike-down did NOT unwind tariff protection, and Section 122 expires July 24 with the Section 301 replacement (~12.5%) pending. Domestic semiconductors remain the strategic capital destination as long as the tariff handoff completes cleanly, and the AI-compute power buildout reinforces chip demand.
theses.thesis_zh: 中美科技战转换是关键的有条件在岸化杠杆：最高法院的裁决并未撤销关税保护，且第 122 条款于 7 月 24 日到期，替代性的第 301 条款（约 12.5%）尚待落地。只要关税交接顺利完成，国内半导体就仍是战略性资本目的地，而 AI 算力电力建设进一步强化芯片需求。
evidence: China theater: SCOTUS strike-down did NOT unwind tariff-protection premium
Open predictions: 25% advanced-chip tariff stays in force and/or covered list expands
Rotation map: Domestic semiconductors/fabs SMH, SOXX under FACT mechanism
theses.dissent: The 2026-07-10 SMH overweight was a marginal hit (+1.4%) but the sector already prices the onshoring premium; a messy Section 301 handoff after July 24 or a China truce that includes tariff relief would remove the protection premium faster than AI-compute demand can replace it.
theses.dissent_zh: 2026 年 7 月 10 日的 SMH 超配仅是小幅命中（+1.4%），但板块已计入在岸化溢价；7 月 24 日后第 301 条款交接不畅或中美休战包含关税减免，将比 AI 算力需求更快地抹去保护溢价。

falsifier.text: SMH lags SPY by 5% or more before early January 2027 while the advanced-chip tariff stays in force
falsifier.text_zh: 在 2027 年 1 月上旬之前，SMH 在先进芯片关税仍然有效的情况下落后 SPY 5% 或以上
